intro: Gujarat Police Recruitment Board (GPRB) has announced 3,000 Class-3 posts in Gujarat Police: 2,841 Lokrakshak (LRD), 133 Head Constable (Driver Mechanic) and 26 Motor Transport Supervisor. The short notice was published in newspapers on 19 November 2026.

Online applications will be accepted on ojas.gujarat.gov.in from 26 November 2026 (2:00 PM) to 16 December 2026 (11:59 PM). The detailed advertisement with age limit, fee and physical standards will be uploaded on OJAS on 26 November — we will update this page as soon as it is out.
